question: If the 5-digit number 688 xy is divisible by 11 and 21, then what is the value of (8x - 3y+ xy)?
solution:
Given:

688xy is divisible by 11 & 21

Concept:

When 688xy is divisible by 11 & 21, it will also be divisible by the LCM of 11 & 21.

Dividend = Divisor x Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

LCM (11, 21) = 231

By taking the largest 5-digit number possible 68899 and divide it by 231.

⇒ 68899/231 = 298.26

Hence,

⇒ 688xy = 231 × 298

⇒ 688xy = 68838

⇒ 688xy = 68838 (where x = 3, y = 8)

Now the value of(8x - 3y+ xy),

⇒ (8x - 3y+ xy) = 8 × 3 - 3 × 8 + 3 × 8

⇒ 24

∴ The value is 24.
